Bash(/tmp/inspect_oplog.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
set -e

DATA_DIR="/tmp/fj_inspect_$"
mkdir -p "$DATA_DIR"
export FLAPJACK_DATA_DIR="$DATA_DIR"
export FLAPJACK_BIND_ADDR="127.0.0.1:17701"

cargo build 2>/dev/null
BINARY="target/debug/flapjack-server"

$BINARY > /tmp/fj_inspect.log 2>&1 &
PID=$!
sleep 2
trap "kill $PID 2>/dev/null || true; rm -rf $DATA_DIR /tmp/fj_inspect.log" EXIT

API="http://127.0.0.1:17701"
HDR=\(-H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "x-algolia-api-key: test"\)

curl -sf -X POST "$API/1/indexes/test/settings" "${HDR[@]}" -d '{"attributesForFaceting":["filterOnly\(cat\)"]}' > /dev/null
curl -sf -X POST "$API/1/indexes/test/batch" "${HDR[@]}" -d '{"requests":[{"action":"addObject","body":{"objectID":"1","name":"Doc 1","cat":"a"}}]}' > /dev/null
sleep 1

kill $PID
sleep 1

echo "=== Oplog contents ==="
if [ -d "$DATA_DIR/test/oplog" ]; then
    for f in "$DATA_DIR/test/oplog"/*.bin; do
        echo "File: $f"
        cat "$f" | head -5
        echo ""
    done
else
    echo "No oplog dir found"
fi

echo "=== Files in tenant dir ==="
ls -la "$DATA_DIR/test/"
EOF)
